After review round 1 (skills and graders had been tuned to each other), the owner moved the gate to deepseek-chat, kept the 0.8 floor and forbade tuning. The honest run failed all four packs (e.g. nodejs-build-fix no-ts-ignore-suppression 0, react-build-fix no-disable-hooks-lint 0, python-build-fix mypy-error-no-blanket-suppress 0, go-testing table-driven-subtests 0.4). The criterion now pins the honest process and the recorded outcome, not a pass.
The honest DeepSeek gate run left all four packs experimental, so by W2 D-7 no pair may ship. The generator and its safety fixes from review round 1 are the deliverable.

No pack cleared the honest gate, so the coverage count must not rise (metrics-and-validation: increases only after a batch passes its gate). The earlier 2 -> 5 journal entry was based on the grader-tuned run that review round 1 invalidated.
